notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 3, the third and last before mainnet, from the sepolia branch: one contract, the ProjectRegistry, the list of projects whose sIMD trading cashback (0.25% to 1% of each trade, at each project's choice, funded from its existing fees) earns points. It is the code the mainnet registry will use, with Sepolia settings, and asks the IdentityMD oracle panel with version 2 of the 8 rules (docs/panel-rules-v2.md, each under 512 characters); this run tests those rules live with applications, a listing and a challenge. Constructor, in order: intake = Intake v2 0xa43e...de82 (live, callback gas 1,000,000; sells a question for ORACLE_FEE() = 0.5 test IMD, read live, never hard-coded); oracleAsset = Sepolia test IMD 0x44a1...f89a, which anyone can mint; stacker = the live Stacker 0x0457...314d of launch #1294 (test run 2); oracleSigner = 0x5598...2982; questionChainId = 1 (the oracle has no Sepolia RPC, so questions are filed under chain 1 and name Sepolia in their text); challengeBond = 5e18 (5 test IMD); challengeCooldown = 3600 seconds. No Stacker, TestIMD or TestSIMD is deployed: the Stacker runs src/Stacker.sol byte for byte (test/SepoliaFork.t.sol checks it) on the live TestIMD 0x2b69...1e82 and TestSIMD 0xf9e2...1cc1 of launch #1129, and PLEA's hook already credits through it; the registry only names it in its questions and never calls it. The registry has no owner, so no $owner argument, and its constructor makes no external call. Anyone calls applyListing(project, name, sourceUrl, rateBps 25-100, beneficiary) or, for a listed project, challengeForBeneficiary(project, reason, beneficiary), paying the oracle fee plus the bond for a challenge; the registry asks one yes-or-no question with requestWithFailure. onOracleResult accepts only the Intake, only its own open request, each answer once, only a signature by the oracle signer for this contract issued after the ask, from a panel of 15 with at least 11 agreeing: yes lists from that block, or keeps a challenged project (bond to its beneficiary, cooldown not restarted); no rejects, or delists from that block (bond back). onOracleFailure only clears the open question and returns a bond; expire clears one after a day or once the Intake completed it; setBeneficiary waits while a question is open. Runtime 22,019 bytes; deployment estimated at about 34.7M gas on Sepolia (read 2026-10-12, block 11,896,540). test/mocks and test/trial hold test doubles only and are not deployed. Once live, the README Deployments table gets the address as "Sepolia test run 3".
